parameters.content:
## Change appointment
Receive change request takes the action (list, cancel or reschedule), the phone from the WhatsApp message, and the appointment's current day and time, plus the new ones for a move. Check change request (src/nodes/plan-appointment-change.ts) validates the action, the fields and, for a move, the new slot with the same rules a new booking passes, before Calendar; anything but a clean first pass returns here.

## Find the appointment
Get upcoming appointments reads Calendar from now to config.limits.max_booking_days_ahead (Always Output Data, so an empty calendar continues). Plan appointment change reruns the same source over those events and keeps only events whose description holds this exact phone line and the assistant's booking line, so an appointment staff made by hand, or one for another phone, is never listed, moved or deleted. It returns one plan: a list, a cancel, a reschedule, or the reason it refused, such as not_found or too_late_to_change.

## Cancel
Delete calendar event removes exactly the event the plan names. If its error says the event is already gone (404 or 410, as a retry of a delete that had worked would get), Was the event already deleted counts it as cancelled; any other failure alerts the team. Mark patient cancelled then sets the Patients row to cancelled and clears its last appointment, or keeps the patient booked, pointing at their next appointment, when they hold another. A cancel returns ok:true only after the event is gone.

## Reschedule
Recheck new slot queries Calendar for exactly [start, end) of the new slot, expanding recurring events. Any event there other than the one being moved means slot_taken, and nothing moves. Otherwise Move calendar event updates that one event's start and end, sending its own title and description back unchanged, and Mark patient rebooked sets the row to booked, with the patient's earliest upcoming appointment as the last appointment.

## Calendar failure
Any Calendar failure alerts the team through notify-team and reports calendar_unavailable, with team_notified set only when that alert sent.
